WITH parts AS (
  SELECT f.period,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.closing_balance) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0), 0) AS bal,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.closing_balance) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0 AND f.dpd_bucket >= 2 AND NOT f.hardship_flag), 0) AS a30_bal,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.closing_balance) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0 AND f.dpd_bucket = 4 AND NOT f.hardship_flag), 0) AS a90_bal,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0 AND f.dpd_bucket = 4 AND NOT f.hardship_flag) AS a90_cnt,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.closing_balance) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0 AND f.hardship_flag), 0) AS hard_bal,
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(f.closing_balance AS DOUBLE) * l.orig_ltv) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0), 0) AS orig_ltv_x_bal,
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(f.closing_balance AS DOUBLE) * f.indexed_ltv) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0), 0) AS idx_ltv_x_bal,
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(f.closing_balance AS DOUBLE) * f.interest_rate) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0), 0) AS rate_x_bal,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.curtailment) FILTER (WHERE f.opening_balance > 0), 0)
      + COALESCE(SUM(f.exit_balance) FILTER (WHERE f.opening_balance > 0 AND f.exit_reason = 'prepaid'), 0) AS smm_num,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.opening_balance - f.scheduled_principal) FILTER (WHERE f.opening_balance > 0 AND (f.exit_reason IS NULL OR f.exit_reason = 'prepaid')), 0) AS smm_den,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.exit_balance) FILTER (WHERE f.opening_balance > 0 AND f.exit_reason = 'defaulted'), 0) AS mdr_num,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.opening_balance) FILTER (WHERE f.opening_balance > 0), 0) AS mdr_den
  FROM fact_loan_month f
  JOIN dim_loan l ON l.loan_id = f.loan_id
  JOIN dim_deal d ON d.deal_id = f.deal_id
  WHERE f.period BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-01'
  GROUP BY f.period
),
b AS (SELECT *, '2026-09' AS period_label FROM parts),
keys AS (SELECT DISTINCT period_label FROM b),
stock AS (
  SELECT period_label, CAST(a90_bal / bal AS DOUBLE) AS arrears_90p_bal
  FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period_label ORDER BY period DESC) AS rn FROM b WHERE loan_count > 0)
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT k.period_label, s.arrears_90p_bal
FROM keys k LEFT JOIN stock s USING (period_label)
ORDER BY k.period_label

WITH parts AS (
  SELECT l.city AS city, f.period,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.closing_balance) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0), 0) AS bal,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.closing_balance) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0 AND f.dpd_bucket >= 2 AND NOT f.hardship_flag), 0) AS a30_bal,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.closing_balance) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0 AND f.dpd_bucket = 4 AND NOT f.hardship_flag), 0) AS a90_bal,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0 AND f.dpd_bucket = 4 AND NOT f.hardship_flag) AS a90_cnt,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.closing_balance) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0 AND f.hardship_flag), 0) AS hard_bal,
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(f.closing_balance AS DOUBLE) * l.orig_ltv) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0), 0) AS orig_ltv_x_bal,
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(f.closing_balance AS DOUBLE) * f.indexed_ltv) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0), 0) AS idx_ltv_x_bal,
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(f.closing_balance AS DOUBLE) * f.interest_rate) FILTER (WHERE f.closing_balance > 0), 0) AS rate_x_bal,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.curtailment) FILTER (WHERE f.opening_balance > 0), 0)
      + COALESCE(SUM(f.exit_balance) FILTER (WHERE f.opening_balance > 0 AND f.exit_reason = 'prepaid'), 0) AS smm_num,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.opening_balance - f.scheduled_principal) FILTER (WHERE f.opening_balance > 0 AND (f.exit_reason IS NULL OR f.exit_reason = 'prepaid')), 0) AS smm_den,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.exit_balance) FILTER (WHERE f.opening_balance > 0 AND f.exit_reason = 'defaulted'), 0) AS mdr_num,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.opening_balance) FILTER (WHERE f.opening_balance > 0), 0) AS mdr_den
  FROM fact_loan_month f
  JOIN dim_loan l ON l.loan_id = f.loan_id
  JOIN dim_deal d ON d.deal_id = f.deal_id
  WHERE f.period BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
  GROUP BY l.city, f.period
),
b AS (SELECT *, CAST(year(period) AS VARCHAR) || '-Q' || CAST(quarter(period) AS VARCHAR) AS period_label FROM parts),
keys AS (SELECT DISTINCT city, period_label FROM b),
flow AS (
  SELECT city, period_label,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE smm_den > 0) = 0 THEN NULL
         WHEN MAX(smm_num / smm_den) FILTER (WHERE smm_den > 0) >= 1 THEN 1.0
         ELSE 1 - EXP(SUM(LN(1 - smm_num / smm_den)) FILTER (WHERE smm_den > 0)) END AS smm_p,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE smm_den > 0) AS smm_n,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mdr_den > 0) = 0 THEN NULL
         WHEN MAX(mdr_num / mdr_den) FILTER (WHERE mdr_den > 0) >= 1 THEN 1.0
         ELSE 1 - EXP(SUM(LN(1 - mdr_num / mdr_den)) FILTER (WHERE mdr_den > 0)) END AS mdr_p,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mdr_den > 0) AS mdr_n
  FROM b GROUP BY city, period_label
)
SELECT k.city, k.period_label, 1 - POWER(1 - w.smm_p, 12.0 / w.smm_n) AS cpr
FROM keys k LEFT JOIN flow w USING (city, period_label)
ORDER BY k.city, k.period_label

  FROM fact_loan_month f

  WHERE f.period BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01' AND f.deal_id IN ('D004')

),
flow AS (
  SELECT period_label,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE smm_den > 0) = 0 THEN NULL
         WHEN MAX(smm_num / smm_den) FILTER (WHERE smm_den > 0) >= 1 THEN 1.0
         ELSE 1 - EXP(SUM(LN(1 - smm_num / smm_den)) FILTER (WHERE smm_den > 0)) END AS smm_p,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE smm_den > 0) AS smm_n,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mdr_den > 0) = 0 THEN NULL

  FROM b GROUP BY period_label
)

ORDER BY k.period_label
